verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਚਕਈ ਚਕਵਾ ਬੰਧਿਕ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਕੀਨੇ ਪਿੰਜਰੀ ਮੈ ਬਸੇ ਨਿਸਿ ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise chakiee chakavaa ba(n)dhik ikatr keene pi(n)jaree mai base nis dhukh sukh maane hai ||

en.bdb: As a bird-catcher catches male and female ruddy sheldrake (Chakvi, Chakva) and put them in the same cage where they remain together for the night, they happily bear the pain of being prisoners because they are spared the pangs of separation for the night.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤ ਪਰਸਪਰ ਕੋਟਿ ਸੁਰ ਜਨ ਵਾਰਉ ਓਟ ਦੁਰਜਨ ਪਰ ਜਾਹਿ ਗਹਿ ਆਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: kahat parasapar koT sur jan vaarau oT dhurajan par jaeh geh aane hai ||

en.bdb: They feel so grateful to the hunter for catching them together and lodging them in the same cage that they sacrifice millions of good people unto him who has given them both a shelter.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਨ ਮਾਤ੍ਰ ਕੋਟਿ ਆਪਦਾ ਸੰਪਦਾ ਕੋਟਿ ਸੰਪਦਾ ਆਪਦਾ ਕੋਟਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਿਸਰਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: simaran maatr koT aapadhaa sa(n)padhaa koT sa(n)padhaa aapadhaa koT prabh bisaraane hai ||

en.bdb: If millions of distresses fall upon a person who is a regular practitioner of Naam Simran, he considers them as having come to aid in his meditation and union with Lord. And if God is slipping out of the memory, then all the luxurious items of life that give pleasure are like millions of sufferings.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਰੂਪ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੨੪੨॥
verses.translit_en: sat roop sat naam satigur giaan dhiaan satigur mat sat sat kar jaane hai ||242||

en.bdb: The practitioner of Lord's name regard His name that the True Guru has blessed him with as the eternal truth and living for ever. He regards and accepts the teachings of True Guru as true and true only. He meditates on Naam with complete devotion. (242)
